The Magical Fluid Laser Base is the Fluid Laser Base of Industrial Foregoing with its screen painted purple: a lens slot that chooses the fluid, a depth that decides where it can be found and a tank of 32000 mB. The Magical Infinity Drill mines a whole area at once and drops everything at your feet, like the Infinity Drill of Industrial Foregoing, but it holds vis instead of power. The more vis it holds, the wider the area, and it falls back to a smaller level as it empties. Its tank takes Liquid Death, which is spent instead of vis.

It is infused on an altar from an ordinary Laser Drill. Vis cost, speed, buffer and sources are set in the configuration.

Lenses raise the chance of the ores of their color, and the work advances every time a Laser Drill, mundane or magical, sends its beam into it.

It is infused on an altar from an ordinary Ore Laser Base. Steps of work and lens weight are set in the configuration.

research.thaumaturgetechcompats.absoluti:
They say permanent madness can never be undone. They also said taint could never be driven out of a living creature.
The voidseer's pearl taught me that the mind can be opened to what lies outside; perhaps it can also be opened to let something leave. A draught far stronger than the clarity potion, fed with the rarest aspects and the gaze of an eldritch eye, might pull a single thread of the madness out from where it has settled.
It will not be cheap, and I doubt it will be gentle.

It works, though only a little at a time. Each draught pulls a measure of permanent warp out of the drinker and leaves them weakened for a long while.
It will take many to be free, and each costs more than the finest brew I have made.Absolution Potion
It is brewed in the crucible from Cognitio, Ordo, Spiritus, Alienis, Praecantatio, Vacuos, Tenebrae, Victus, Auram and Perditio, with an Eldritch Eye as the catalyst. How much it removes per draught and its side effect are set in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.akashic_:
I have studied enough of the world to peel back the fabric of reality, and still there is always more to learn.
A record holding every thought that has ever been thought may exist, if I can bind a spark of knowledge to the purest ingots of infinity.
The Akashic Records are complete. Opening them floods the mind with every aspect there is, hundreds of points of each, and then a little more.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.aura_con: Thaumium holds magic, but it lets it slip away slowly. Alchemical brass, bound to the aura since the crucible, should keep far more of it in store and hand it out in a steadier stream.

The brass wraps the resonator and nothing is lost on the way out.<PAGE>Alchemical Brass Aura Converter<DIV>It is infused over a thaumium aura converter with alchemical brass plates, a simple mechanism and a vis resonator. Every vis becomes 1,000,000 FE. It gives out up to 1,000,000 FE per tick and stores 100,000,000 FE.

The aura is a store of power that nobody has learned to tap without a wand or a machine of the arcane. If a vis generator can feed on a flame, a device built around a resonator should be able to feed on the aura itself, and hand back its strength as plain current.

The resonator has been tuned to the aura of the chunk and the thaumium carries the current away.Thaumium Aura Converter
It is crafted at the arcane workbench from thaumium plates, copper, redstone, a vis resonator and a simple mechanism. It drains vis from the aura of its chunk and turns every vis into 250,000 FE. It gives out up to 250,000 FE per tick and stores 10,000,000 FE. It gives the energy to every neighbouring block that accepts it and never takes any in.
Right-click it to see the stored energy, the aura of the chunk, its state and its rate. Every vis it converts leaves a little flux behind, it never drains the aura under a quarter of its base, and all the converters of a chunk share a limit on what they can drain. A redstone signal stops it. The figures can be changed in the configuration.

The void swallows everything that comes near it, aura included. A converter of void metal should drink the aura faster than any other and keep almost all of it as current, as long as the aura is there to drink.

The void drinks the aura and gives it back as pure power.<PAGE>Void Metal Aura Converter<DIV>It is infused over an alchemical brass aura converter with void metal plates, a complex mechanism and two vis resonators. Every vis becomes 560,000,000 FE. It gives out up to 500,000,000 FE per tick and stores 10,000,000,000 FE. The limit of the chunk keeps it from emptying the aura on its own.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.avaritia:
A mnemonic matrix lets a thaumatorium remember two more formulas at the same time, but the clockwork inside is small and fragile.
If its frame is rebuilt from plates of crystal matrix, neutronium and infinity, the same matrix should hold many more formulas without losing a single one.

Each matrix is made on an infusion altar, starting from the one before it:
- The Crystal Matrix one starts from an ordinary mnemonic matrix.
- The Neutronium one starts from the Crystal Matrix one.
- The Infinity one starts from the Neutronium one.
They are placed against a thaumatorium exactly like the ordinary ones, and they stack with them. By default they allow 4, 6 and 10 formulas at the same time.
Mnemonic Matrices of Avaritia

Some tools of Thaumaturge were never meant to be built by mortal hands: a device that plants whole nodes in the aura, and a Thaumonomicon that already knows every secret there is to know.
With the Akashic Records, the pearls and plates of infinity and a great deal of aspects, an infusion altar might be forced to forge them anyway.

Both artifacts are made on an infusion altar:
- The Creative Node Placer is infused from a Node Jar, with infinity and neutronium plates, neutron ingots and primordial pearls.
- The Cheater's Thaumonomicon is infused from a Thaumonomicon, with the Akashic Records, an Extremely Primordial Pearl, infinity plates and infinity ingots.
Their power is the same as the ones from the creative world, so I should use them with care.
Creative Artifacts

Even a Greater Focus runs out of room when I try to weave a truly grand spell into it. Crystal matrix holds order without losing any of it, and infinity holds anything at all.
The foci must be built on top of one another, and the aspect of the end of things will keep the crystal from shattering.

All three are infused on top of a Greater Focus or another improved focus.
- Crystal Matrix Focus: a Greater Focus, two crystal matrix ingots and two crystal matrix plates. Holds a bigger spell than any focus before it.
- Infinity Focus: a Crystal Matrix Focus, two infinity ingots, two infinity plates and two neutronium plates. The most capable focus there is.
- Blaze Cube Focus: a Greater Focus, two blaze cubes and two crystal matrix plates. Not as deep as the matrix focus, but it fans out into many more branches and repeats, which suits a barrage of fire.
Improved Foci

The advanced alchemical furnace is hungry, but it still waits between every item it breaks down and it still squanders part of the heat, perditio and aqua it burns.
If its heart were one of the Avaritia smelteries, the same walls should hold a furnace that works much faster and wastes far less.

The structure is exactly that of the Advanced Alchemical Furnace, a three by three base with two layers, but the essentia smeltery at its centre is the matching Avaritia smeltery: Crystal Matrix, Neutronium or Infinity. Salis mundus sprinkled over it brings it to life, and since every smeltery needs the one before it, every furnace needs the one before it too.
- Crystal Matrix: waits half as long between items and gives back 25% of the heat, perditio and aqua it burns.
- Neutronium: waits a quarter as long and gives back 50%.
- Infinity: waits a tenth as long and gives back 90%.
If a part is broken the furnace turns back into its smeltery. They draw and release essentia exactly like the Advanced Alchemical Furnace.
Avaritia Alchemical Furnaces

Thaumium and void metal are strong, but the ingots of Avaritia are on another level entirely.
Crystal matrix is light and clear, neutronium is impossibly dense and infinity is simply beyond measure. Pressed into plates, they should make golems unlike any I have built before.

Three ingots pressed in a crafting grid make three plates. Neutronium plates also need a Crystal Matrix Plate, and infinity plates a Neutronium Plate.
- Crystal Matrix: light, fireproof and blastproof.
- Neutronium: heavy, armored, fireproof and blastproof.
- Infinity: the sturdiest of all, brutal, armored, fireproof, blastproof and self-repairing.
Each plate is the base of a golem in the Golem Press, together with a Complex Arcane Mechanism.
The plates are also ingredients for the wand caps and rods and for the improved foci of this chapter.
Material Studies: Avaritia

A warded jar is only as good as the glass it is made from, and ordinary glass can only be warded so far.
Crystal matrix, neutronium and infinity are all materials that bend the rules of what a vessel can contain. If I wrap a warded jar in them, it should hold far more essentia than any jar I have seen before.

Each jar is made on an infusion altar, starting from a plain warded jar:
- The Crystal Matrix Jar is surrounded by crystal matrix ingots.
- The Neutronium Jar needs a Crystal Matrix Jar and neutron ingots.
- The Infinity Jar needs a Neutronium Jar, infinity ingots and an Extremely Primordial Pearl.
They work like any other warded jar, only larger. Labels and braces fit them as usual, and essentia is kept when the jar is picked up.
Jars of Avaritia

The Neutronium Collector and Compressor of Avaritia already grow through three denser forms, yet even the Densest one is slow to a mind that has seen the Terminus. If the infusion altar could lend them the metals that stretched my jars, they should work faster still.
Thaumium, alchemical brass and void metal might let these machines run several times over in a single tick, and give more for the same work.

Every machine is made on an infusion altar, starting from the one before it:
- The Thaumium Neutron Collector and Compressor need the Densest Neutronium Collector or Compressor, four thaumium plates and a Simple Arcane Mechanism.
- The Brass Neutron Collector and Compressor need the Thaumium machine, four alchemical brass plates and a Simple Arcane Mechanism.
- The Void Neutron Collector and Compressor need the Brass machine, four void metal plates and a Void Seed.
They work exactly like the machines of Avaritia and use the same recipes, only faster, and each tier also gives more every time it finishes. How much faster and how much more is set in the configuration.
Each tier can only be infused on an altar whose center is the Runic Matrix of its own tier, and that matrix brings its own instability to the craft:
- The Thaumium machines need the Crystal Matrix one: solar instability, with fires, lightning and burns.
- The Brass machines need the Neutronium one: nuclear instability, with radiation, flux poured into the aura and a meltdown that explodes.
- The Void machines need the Infinity one: cosmic instability, with flux torn open, warp, creatures from beyond and everything nearby thrown elsewhere.
The Brass and Void machines also ask for two new essences. Nuclear, made of potentia and perditio, is the power locked in the heart of matter. Cosmic, made of alienis and auram, is the vastness between the stars. The Brass machines ask for Nuclear, and the Void machines ask for Nuclear and Cosmic.
Higher Neutronium Machines

My scribing tools run dry far too quickly. Every aspect I place on a research note drains a little of the ink, and a long night of research can empty a whole set.
A quill and an inkwell made of crystal matrix, neutronium and infinity should hold much more ink, and the last of them may never run out.

Each set is made on an infusion altar, starting from ordinary scribing tools:
- The Crystal Matrix tools are surrounded by crystal matrix ingots.
- The Neutronium tools need the Crystal Matrix tools and neutron ingots.
- The Infinity tools need the Neutronium tools, infinity ingots and an Extremely Primordial Pearl.
All of them work on a research table exactly like ordinary scribing tools. The Infinity tools restore their ink on their own while I carry them. The Crystal Matrix and Neutronium tools can be refilled with black dye, like the ordinary ones.
Scribing Tools of Avaritia

The void metal smeltery is the best that ordinary metals can give me, and it still wastes essentia and takes its time about it.
The ingots of Avaritia are another matter. Crystal matrix is almost lattice-perfect, neutronium holds more mass than any vessel should, and infinity holds everything. If I rebuild the smeltery out of them, nothing should be lost to flux any more.

Each smeltery is built on the one before it, with five plates and two ingots of its own material and an advanced alchemical construct:
- Crystal Matrix: 97% efficiency, hands slurry over every 8 ticks.
- Neutronium: 98.5% efficiency, every 5 ticks.
- Infinity: perfect efficiency, so no essentia is ever lost, every 2 ticks.
They work exactly like the other smelteries, with the same alembics, slurry pumps, venting ports and bellows.
Avaritia Smelteries

The advanced stabilizer holds a node steady, yet the node still feeds a little on the aura and it still takes its time to settle when it is unstable or fading. A lock this important deserves a better frame.
Crystal matrix, neutronium and infinity should each give a frame that grips a node harder than the last. I will need a strong infusion to bind such metals around a stabilizer that already works.

Each stabilizer is infused around the previous one, using plates and ingots of its own material alternating with nitor and alumentum:
- Crystal Matrix: around an Advanced Node Stabilizer.
- Neutronium: around the Crystal Matrix one.
- Infinity: around the Neutronium one.
All three hold a node the way an Advanced Node Stabilizer does: nothing can pull from it, it can still pull from unprotected nodes nearby, and a redstone signal switches them off. What changes is the grip:
- Crystal Matrix: the node feeds on the aura 50 times slower than normal, and unstable or fading nodes settle 3 times as fast as with the basic stabilizer.
- Neutronium: 200 times slower, and 4 times as fast.
- Infinity: 1000 times slower, and 5 times as fast. The node practically stops feeding.
Avaritia Node Stabilizers

Waking a node with the plain transducer is slow work. Every point of power must be fed in one tick at a time, and while the signal flickers the charge leaks away just as slowly.
The ingots of Avaritia carry far more current. A transducer shaped from them should pour power into a node many times faster, and hold on to it longer.

Each transducer is built around the previous one, with four plates and two ingots of its own material, a comparator and a nitor:
- Crystal Matrix: charges a node 2 times faster and loses charge half as fast.
- Neutronium: 4 times faster, with a charge that fades 4 times slower.
- Infinity: 10 times faster, with a charge that fades 10 times slower.
They are placed above a stabilized node and powered with redstone exactly like the Node Transducer, and they drain the same single point of aspect each tick, so the node is energized for a fraction of the aspects.
Avaritia Node Transducers

The workbench charger pulls vis from the aura of the chunks around my arcane workbench, but it reaches only a short distance and wastes a lot on the way.
Plates of crystal matrix, neutronium and infinity should let it reach much farther and spend far less of the aura on every craft.

Each charger is made on an infusion altar, starting from the one before it:
- The Crystal Matrix one starts from an ordinary workbench charger.
- The Neutronium one starts from the Crystal Matrix one.
- The Infinity one starts from the Neutronium one.
They sit on top of the workbench like the ordinary one. By default they draw from 2, 3 and 4 chunks around it and charge only 70%, 40% and 10% of the vis of each craft.
Workbench Chargers of Avaritia
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.biome_pu:
The purification potion cures the creatures the taint has taken, but the land itself stays sick. The same flux that sickens the flesh stains the soil, the stone and the sky above them, and the aura of the chunk cannot recover while the stain remains.
An ethereal bloom cleans slowly, and a seed left alone keeps feeding the stain. If a potion could carry the whole cleansing of a bloom in one breath, a single throw might undo what a seed has spread over the land.
I will need a firm grasp of the aura and of alchemy before I trust a brew with that much order in it.

The brew is ready. Thrown at the ground, it bursts into a pale green mist that does in one breath the work of an ethereal bloom: the tainted biome returns to what the land was, fibres, crust, soil and growths wither away, flux goo and gas wash out, and any taint seed caught in the mist is destroyed.
It also draws flux out of the aura of the chunks it touches.Biome Purification Potion
It is brewed in the crucible from Ordo, Victus, Aqua, Lux, Auram, Praecantatio, Vitreus and Herba, with a Purification Splash Potion as the catalyst. The area, the flux it draws and what it cleans are set in the configuration.
