The Gaia Spreader is the finest the botanists can build, and still its bursts are small and slow beside what an infusion altar could wake in them. If the metals that widened my jars were set into the spreader, it should hold far more mana and throw it much harder.
Thaumium, alchemical brass and void metal should each carry a spreader a step further than the last.

Every spreader is made on an infusion altar, starting from the one before it:
- The Thaumium Mana Spreader needs a Gaia Spreader, four thaumium plates and a Simple Arcane Mechanism.
- The Alchemical Brass Mana Spreader needs the Thaumium one, four alchemical brass plates and a Simple Arcane Mechanism.
- The Void Metal Mana Spreader needs the Alchemical Brass one, four void metal plates and a Void Seed.
They work like any other spreader, take lenses and can be bound with the Wand of the Forest. How much mana a burst carries, how much the spreader holds, how far and how fast the burst flies and what colour it has is set in the configuration for each tier.

The botanists grow wood that is alive and wood that dreams, and forge steel from mana, from the elves and from the earth itself. All of it hums with a power that is not vis, yet it should still be bent into a wand.
A rod of living or dreaming wood and a cap of one of their metals should make a wand of a kind nobody has built before.

The rod and the cap are separate parts, and any rod fits any cap:
- The Livingwood Rod is crafted from three Livingwood Twigs at an arcane workbench. The Dreamwood Rod is infused from it with four Dreamwood Twigs.
- The Manasteel Cap is crafted from five Manasteel Ingots at an arcane workbench. The Elementium Cap and the Terrasteel Cap are infused from it, with Elementium Ingots and Pixie Dust or with Terrasteel Ingots and a Mana Diamond.
Dreamwood holds more vis than livingwood. The Manasteel and Terrasteel caps make every spell cheaper, and the Elementium Cap makes the primal aspects of air, water, earth and fire cheaper still. The exact values are set in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.clarity_:
Part of the madness a thaumaturge gathers is passing, and fades with time, yet it lingers exactly when it hurts the most. Sanity soap scrubs the skin; I want something that reaches the mind itself.
Cognition to hold the thought, order to put it back in its place and spirit to carry it out: a draught of the three, sweetened with the soap that already knows how to clean, should wash the passing madness away.

The draught is clear as spring water and tastes of nothing. Drunk, it takes the temporary warp out of the mind at once.
It does not touch the warp that has settled for good, and the drinker may feel a brief unease afterwards.Clarity Potion
It is brewed in the crucible from Cognitio, Ordo, Spiritus, Aqua, Victus and Alienis, with a Sanity Soap as the catalyst. How much it removes and its side effect are set in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.create_c: A machine is only as fast as the hand that drives it. If I wrap a Create casing in alchemical brass and build the machines of Create around it, an aura node close by should be able to speed up the machinery inside.

The casing hums beside a node. Built into a machine of Create it makes a variant of that machine: a mechanical press, mixer, saw or drill, a deployer, millstone, basin, spout, item drain or depot that works exactly like the original.
While an aura node is near, the variant works many times faster. Away from every node it behaves as the plain machine.Alchemical Brass Casing
It is made at the arcane workbench from a brass casing of Create and four brass plates.Machine variants
Each variant is infused over the matching machine of Create, with an alchemical brass casing and two brass plates.
Thaumium drinks magic far more readily than brass. A casing forged from it, and the machines built with it, should answer a node at a greater distance.

The thaumium variants reach nodes from farther away than the alchemical brass ones.<PAGE>Thaumium Casing<DIV>It is infused over an alchemical brass casing with four thaumium plates and a simple mechanism.<PAGE>Machine variants<DIV>Each variant is infused over the alchemical brass variant of the same machine, with a thaumium casing, two thaumium plates and a simple mechanism.
Void metal swallows whatever feeds it. A casing made of it, and the machines built with it, should pull the most out of a node.

The void metal variants are the finest, and answer a node from the greatest distance.<PAGE>Void Metal Casing<DIV>It is infused over a thaumium casing with four void metal plates and a complex mechanism.<PAGE>Machine variants<DIV>Each variant is infused over the thaumium variant of the same machine, with a void metal casing, two void metal plates and a complex mechanism.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.create_s: Create's machines are fed by belts, depots and basins, and none of them take orders from a golem. A control seal that speaks their language of inventories and levers might change that.

The seal sits on a block of Create and lets a golem work it.
It inserts the items the golem carries into the block, takes items out of it, and can also click the block, which turns hand cranks and valve handles.
The filter picks the items for every task, and each task can be switched off in the seal's options.Create Seal
It is infused over a Use Seal with a cogwheel, a brass sheet, andesite alloy and a simple mechanism.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.create_t:
A node pours out more power than any hand crank ever could, and it does so without asking for water or wind. A motor of brass and thaumium that drinks that power should turn a shaft by itself.
It would have to take what it needs from a source standing close by, and a hungry node is never a safe one.

The Thaummotor is made on an arcane workbench from a brass casing, two shafts, two simple mechanisms and four thaumium plates.
While a jarred node, a node, a Flux Jar or a flux rift stands within reach, it takes a little power from it every so often and turns at a fixed speed, providing stress to the whole kinetic network. The richer the source, the more stress it provides, and with no source, or no power left in it, it stops. A hungry node is never a valid source. The goggles of Create tell which source it is using.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.enderio_:
A single capacitor inside a machine is not enough for a long night. The engineers of Ender IO bind capacitor banks into one great reservoir, and each bank links to every neighbour of its own kind. If my vis-forged capacitors beat the octadic one, banks lined with them should hold far more than the vibrant bank.
Each metal should give a bank that beats the one before it.

Every bank is infused from the one below it, with four plates of the new metal and four capacitors of that same metal. The Thaumium Capacitor Bank is infused from a Vibrant Capacitor Bank, the Alchemical Brass one from the Thaumium bank, and the Void Metal one from the Alchemical Brass bank.
They work like the banks of Ender IO: place them touching and they share a single pool of energy, but only banks of the same kind join together. The capacity of each one is set in the configuration.

The octadic capacitor is the best the engineers of Ender IO can build, and every machine of theirs answers to the capacitor it holds. A capacitor that stores vis-forged metal in its layers should push them well past that.
Each metal I have mastered should give a capacitor that beats the one before it.

Every capacitor is infused from the one below it, with four plates of the new metal, two Vibrant Alloy Ingots and a Vibrant Crystal. The Thaumium Capacitor is infused from an Octadic Capacitor, the Alchemical Brass Capacitor from the Thaumium one, and the Void Metal Capacitor from the Alchemical Brass one. Alchemical Brass adds a simple mechanism and Void Metal a void seed.
They go in the capacitor slot of any Ender IO machine and work like an octadic capacitor with a higher level, so the machine stores more energy and works faster. The exact levels are set in the configuration.

The conduits of Ender IO carry power, items and fluids through walls and across rooms, but even the vibrant ones have a limit. If I bind thaumaturgic metal into them, the limit should be mine to set.
Each metal I have mastered should give a conduit that outruns the one before it.

Every conduit is made at the arcane workbench from the one below it, with four plates of the new metal, two Conduit Binders and a material of its kind: a Vibrant Alloy Ingot for energy, a Pulsating Alloy Ingot for items and a Vibrant Crystal for fluids. One conduit makes eight.
The Thaumium conduits are made from the vibrant conduits of Ender IO, the Alchemical Brass ones from the Thaumium ones, and the Void Metal ones from the Alchemical Brass ones. Thaumium adds a fifth plate, Alchemical Brass a simple mechanism and Void Metal a void seed.
The workbench also needs vis and crystals: ignis for energy, aer for items and aqua for fluids, with order crystals, and more of everything for each metal.
Energy conduits move more RF every tick, item conduits move more items and cycle faster, and fluid conduits move more mB every tick. The exact values are set in the configuration.

The alloys of Ender IO were made to carry power, and power is only a step away from vis. A rod and a cap drawn from them, from the humble redstone alloy to the end steel forged beyond the world, should make wands that grow stronger with every metal.
Ten materials, ten rods and ten caps, each one better than the last.

The rod and the cap are separate parts, and any rod fits any cap. The materials, from weakest to strongest, are redstone alloy, conductive alloy, pulsating alloy, energetic alloy, dark steel, soularium, pulsating crystal, vibrant alloy, vibrant crystal and end steel.
- The first three are crafted at an arcane workbench: a rod from three ingots and a cap from five.
- Every other rod and cap is infused from the part of the material before it, with four ingots, or four crystals for the crystal ones.
Stronger materials hold more vis in the rod and make every spell cheaper with the cap, and each cap makes its own aspects cheaper still. The crystals, the vibrant alloy and the end steel glow. The exact values are set in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.extremel:
The primordial pearl is potent, yet I cannot shake the feeling that it could be taken much further.
If several pearls were crushed together inside an infusion altar, their power might fold in on itself and become something far beyond a mere pearl. The old texts have no name for such a thing, so I will call it the Extremely Primordial Pearl.
I will need the aspect of the end of things to bind them together.

The altar has done it. The Extremely Primordial Pearl hums with a power that is more primordial than any pearl has a right to be.
It does not seem to be spent when I work with it, so it will serve as an everlasting catalyst.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.farmersd: Thaumium was only the beginning. Alchemical brass, worked into the same blade, should keep an edge that no mundane steel could.

The brass keeps its edge as the thaumium cannot.<PAGE>Alchemical Brass Knife<DIV>Craft it at the arcane workbench with an alchemical brass plate over a Thaumium Knife. It works like any Farmer's Delight knife and is sturdier, sharper and easier to enchant than the thaumium one.
The void metal blade does not only drink what it cuts. If I feed it vitium, it should bite into the world itself and leave a seam, and whatever it slices at the table should leave as flux in the air.

A seam in the air, and the kitchen smells of rust.Flux Knife
Infuse a void metal knife with two Flux Crystals, Tainted Goo and a Bottle of Taint. Sneak and use it on a block to open a flux rift beside it. The rift is sized to the flux it takes from the aura of that chunk, and if the chunk does not have enough the knife opens nothing. Every rift wears the blade and the knife needs a pause before the next one.
On the Cutting Board it is a Farmer's Delight knife in every way, except that the food it cuts also adds flux to the air, more for what feeds better. Depending on the configuration it may not leave the food at all.
A plate of thaumium, a stick and a little vis. Farmer's Delight already taught me what a good knife is for; thaumium should give it a better edge.

The thaumium takes a keener edge than iron ever did, and it hums when it cuts.<PAGE>Thaumium Knife<DIV>Craft it at the arcane workbench with a thaumium plate over a stick. It is a Farmer's Delight knife in every way: it cuts on the Cutting Board and counts as a knife for any recipe that asks for one. It lasts longer, hits harder and enchants better than the iron knife.
The void metal drinks everything it touches. A blade of it would cut deeper than any other, and it would not cut clean.

The void drinks the light off the blade, and what it cuts does not heal clean.<PAGE>Void Metal Knife<DIV>Craft it at the arcane workbench with a void metal plate over an Alchemical Brass Knife. It is the best Farmer's Delight knife I can make, on the Cutting Board and in the hand. Sometimes a hit with it leaves Flux Taint on whatever it struck.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.field_fl: Levitation is a trick of the void, and the void answers to controlled discharges. A module that stores dimensional flux and spends it in short bursts at my back could lift me, and keep me from falling too.

The Flight Thruster is infused from a thaumium chestplate, with three brass plates, two complex mechanisms, a void seed and two vis resonators.
It is worn on the chest and holds Dimensional Flux, which an environmental charger can refill. While you hold jump in the air it thrusts you upwards, and forward as well if you hold the forward key, in bursts that need a moment to cool down. It also takes the fall out of any fall while it holds flux. Without flux it does nothing.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.field_sh: The bubble is too small for what I want to protect. Brass carries the flux better and should let the barrier grow.

The Alchemical Brass Shield Generator is infused from a thaumium one, with four brass plates, a simple mechanism, a vis resonator and two mirrored glass.
It holds more flux and projects a much wider bubble.

A wall does not have to be stone. If the barrier of a mirror shield could be cast around a whole place, fed by a steady supply of dimensional flux, nothing hostile would ever reach what stands inside.

The Thaumium Shield Generator is made on an arcane workbench from four thaumium plates, two mirrored glass, two simple mechanisms and a vis resonator.
While it holds Dimensional Flux it raises a bubble around itself that destroys the projectiles of hostile mobs, pushes hostile mobs out and takes the damage out of explosions inside. Every tick of the bubble costs flux, and so does every projectile and every explosion it absorbs. When the flux runs out it shuts down, and it starts again once it has recovered enough. Right-click it to read its state.
Void metal does not reflect: it swallows. A barrier woven from it should stop what brass can only turn away, and reach as far as a small fortress.

The Void Metal Shield Generator is infused from an alchemical brass one, with four void metal plates, a complex mechanism, two vis resonators and a mirrored glass.
It holds the most flux and projects the widest bubble, at a price in flux per tick to match.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.field_te: A single machine works too slowly and reaches too little. With brass in its channels it should change more land, faster.

The Alchemical Brass Arcane Terraformer is infused from a thaumium one, with four brass plates, a simple mechanism, a vis resonator, a cactus and a block of snow.
It repaints a wider area, several columns at a time, and for less flux per column.
Biomes are only a matter of aspects that have settled in a place. A machine that knows the aspects of a desert, or of a taiga, could press them into the land around it, column by column.

The Thaumium Arcane Terraformer is made on an arcane workbench from four thaumium plates, grass, sand, two simple mechanisms and a vis resonator.
Right-click it with an item that stands for a biome, such as sand for a desert, snow for the tundra or a sapling for a forest, and it takes the flux of the network to repaint the area around it, column by column, starting at its feet. Sneak and right-click it with an empty hand to take the bait back. Biomes and dimensions listed in the configuration are left alone. Right-click it to read its progress.
A continent is not out of reach for a machine that does not care what it empties to do its work.

The Void Metal Arcane Terraformer is infused from an alchemical brass one, with four void metal plates, a complex mechanism, two vis resonators and a red mushroom.
It repaints the widest area, the fastest and for the least flux per column.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.flux_cha: Thaumium reaches little and gives little. A frame of alchemical brass should cast the same field much farther and much faster.

The Alchemical Brass Environmental Charger is made on an infusion altar from a Thaumium Environmental Charger, four brass plates, a simple mechanism and a vis resonator.
It works like the thaumium one, only with a wider radius, a higher rate and a bigger store.

A recharge pedestal gives one thing its fill and then asks me to carry it back. Dimensional Flux, once it flows through my network, should not need such a ritual.
A block that gives it away into the air around it could recharge everything I carry without me ever taking anything out of my pack.

The Thaumium Environmental Charger is made on an arcane workbench from seven thaumium plates, a vis resonator and a simple mechanism.
It releases energy in a nearby area to automatically recharge the objects and tools you carry in your inventory. It keeps its own store of Dimensional Flux, which transmission links, storage cores and extractors fill by pushing into it, and every few ticks it gives a share to each charged item, wand and vis item of every player in reach. Right click it to read its state, its radius and its rate.
The void swallows whatever it is given. If I teach it to give back instead, a charger of void metal should fill whatever stands in its field before it has time to notice.

The Void Metal Environmental Charger is made on an infusion altar from an Alchemical Brass Environmental Charger, four void metal plates, a complex mechanism and two vis resonators.
It works like the others, with the widest radius, the highest rate and the biggest store.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.flux_dis: Dimensional Flux is only energy, and energy only needs a mouth narrow enough. A tube of void metal, a complex mechanism and a seed of the void could squeeze a whole store of it into a single shot.

The Discharge Cannon is made on an infusion altar from a complex mechanism, four void metal plates, two void seeds and two vis resonators.
It is a weapon that concentrates the stored energy to fire high impact projectiles. Hold right click to charge it and release to fire: the shot crosses the air up to its range, hurts what it hits hard and the creatures around the impact a little, and uses a fixed amount of Dimensional Flux. Without charge it will not fire, and it needs a short rest between shots.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.flux_por: The void siphon on my land pulls stray flux out of the aura and gives me seeds in return. If I could carry its hunger in my hand, I could gather what lies about me and take the leftover energy of the aura along with it.

The Portable Void Siphon is made on an arcane workbench from three brass plates, a void seed and a simple mechanism.
It is a portable tool that absorbs matter and residual energy from a distance. While right click is held down it pulls the items lying around and the experience orbs towards you, and it uses Dimensional Flux every second to do so. At the same time it draws the flux of the aura of the chunk and turns it into Dimensional Flux of its own, which also cleans the aura a little. Without charge it does nothing, and the Environmental Charger recharges it in your pack.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.flux_rif:
A flux rift is a wound in space, and what leaks out of it is pure energy. A jar can catch a little of it as power, but a machine could take it straight from the tear: Dimensional Flux, energy drawn from open rifts to feed advanced machinery.
It would have to eat the rift as it drinks, shrinking it a little with every sip.

The Rift Extractor is made on an infusion altar from a Flux Jar, a void seed, four void metal plates and a complex arcane mechanism.
It absorbs energy directly from an open flux rift within reach, taking one point of its size every so often, and turns each point into Dimensional Flux. It stops once the rift is down to its smallest size or once it has no room left to store more. The Flux it holds is pushed into the storages and Transmission Links that touch it.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.flux_sto: A bigger reserve asks for a sturdier vessel. Alchemical brass takes a stronger charge than thaumium does, and a core made of it should keep far more flux, so long as its ring is made of brass too.

The Alchemical Brass Flux Storage Core and the Alchemical Brass Flux Capacity Cell are made by infusion, the first from the Thaumium Flux Storage Core and the second from the Thaumium Flux Capacity Cell.<PAGE>Structure<DIV>The core only works while it is the centre of a ring of eight alchemical brass blocks on its own level, with one more alchemical brass block right above it and another right below it. Blocks of a higher tier count too. Until it is formed it neither stores nor passes on any flux. Right-click it to see its state.<PAGE>Cells and stabilizers<DIV>Capacity Cells placed on pedestals, of any kind, within six blocks of the core raise its capacity. Node stabilizers within eight blocks keep it calm: the fuller it is, the more stabilizer points it needs. Above half full and short of points, it overloads: it releases flux into the aura, throws sparks and hurts whoever stands near. The distances, figures and effects can be changed in the configuration.

Every machine of my network hungers for the same thing, and so far I have nowhere to keep it. A block of thaumium, ringed by more of its own kind, should hold a great reserve of dimensional flux without letting it slip away.
But a reserve that grows too full will want to spill, and something will have to hold it still.

The Thaumium Flux Storage Core and the Thaumium Flux Capacity Cell are made at the arcane workbench.<PAGE>Structure<DIV>The core only works while it is the centre of a ring of eight thaumium blocks on its own level, with one more thaumium block right above it and another right below it. Blocks of a higher tier count too. Until it is formed it neither stores nor passes on any flux. Right-click it to see its state.<PAGE>Cells and stabilizers<DIV>Capacity Cells placed on pedestals, of any kind, within six blocks of the core raise its capacity. Node stabilizers within eight blocks keep it calm: the fuller it is, the more stabilizer points it needs. Above half full and short of points, it overloads: it releases flux into the aura, throws sparks and hurts whoever stands near. The distances, figures and effects can be changed in the configuration.
There is a metal that drinks everything it is given and never fills. A core of void metal should keep a reserve beyond measure, and it will be the most dangerous of all when its stabilizers fail.

The Void Metal Flux Storage Core and the Void Metal Flux Capacity Cell are made by infusion, the first from the Alchemical Brass Flux Storage Core and the second from the Alchemical Brass Flux Capacity Cell.<PAGE>Structure<DIV>The core only works while it is the centre of a ring of eight void metal blocks on its own level, with one more void metal block right above it and another right below it. Blocks of a higher tier count too. Until it is formed it neither stores nor passes on any flux. Right-click it to see its state.<PAGE>Cells and stabilizers<DIV>Capacity Cells placed on pedestals, of any kind, within six blocks of the core raise its capacity. Node stabilizers within eight blocks keep it calm: the fuller it is, the more stabilizer points it needs. Above half full and short of points, it overloads: it releases flux into the aura, throws sparks and hurts whoever stands near. The distances, figures and effects can be changed in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.flux_tra:
Dimensional Flux is of no use where it is born. Something has to redirect and connect the beams of energy over a distance, between devices that never touch.
Two pieces of the same make, each tuned to the other, should do it.

The Thaumium Transmission Link is made on an arcane workbench from thaumium plates, quicksilver and a simple arcane mechanism, and the recipe gives two of them. The Transmission Linker is made from quicksilver, a thaumium plate and a simple arcane mechanism.
Use the linker on one link and then on another to pair them; sneak and use it on a link to break the pair. Each link has a single partner, and the beam between them is visible. Flux flows both ways until both buffers are equally full, and a link also takes flux from the storages next to it and gives it to the ones that can receive it. Links placed side by side pass flux along, so chains are possible. The reach of a pair is the smaller of the two, and it only works while both ends are loaded.
Thaumium carries a trickle of Flux a short way. Brass, which holds the work of the crucible, should carry a stream much further.

The Alchemical Brass Transmission Link is made on an infusion altar from a Thaumium Transmission Link, alchemical brass plates, a simple arcane mechanism and quicksilver.
It reaches farther and moves far more Flux every tick. It can be paired with a link of another tier, but the pair only reaches as far and moves only as much as the weaker of the two.
The void does not care about distance. A link made of it should barely notice it.

The Void Metal Transmission Link is made on an infusion altar from an Alchemical Brass Transmission Link, void metal plates, a complex arcane mechanism and a void seed.
It has the greatest reach and the highest rate of all the links. It can be paired with a link of another tier, but the pair only reaches as far and moves only as much as the weaker of the two.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.forcecra: The Force Infuser can bind a charge into a tool, but it knows nothing of mending. An order shard, though, is order itself, and order is what a broken edge longs for. If the infuser feeds one to a tool, it should learn to drink the aura and put itself back together.

The infuser has taught the tool to mend itself.Repair
Place an Order Shard in one of the eight slots around a Force tool, a Force armor piece or a Force Rod, with an Upgrade Tome of the seventh tier in the book slot. The infusion can be added to a tool that is already infused.
From then on the item slowly repairs itself while it is in the inventory, drawing vis from the aura of the chunk where its owner stands. If the aura is empty, nothing is repaired.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.ftbunear: Fine bristles and a handle of brass are all it takes to separate a grain of something precious from a heap of sand. The villagers of the Unearther already know the trade; I only have to give them a better tool.

The brass holds its edge and the bristles do not fray.<PAGE>Brass Brush<DIV>It is made at the arcane workbench from a feather, a brass plate and a stick. Used on sand or gravel, by hand or inside the Unearther of FTB Unearthed, it can unearth vis crystals, amber and raw cinnabar. The odds and the durability are the lowest of the three brushes.
Alchemical brass answers the aura better than thaumium. A core of brass should be able to drink deeper from the aura than one of thaumium, and spend it better.

The Alchemical Brass Unearther is made at the arcane workbench from a Thaumium Unearther core, four alchemical brass plates and two simple mechanisms.
It looks for power over a wider area and works much faster than the thaumium one, at the price of taking more power each time. A hungry node is never a safe source.

The villagers of the Unearther work faster when they are fed, but a thaumaturge has better things to offer than bread. A core cut from thaumium, which keeps whatever power is poured into it, set where the aura is strong, should be able to feed on that instead.

The Thaumium Unearther is made at the arcane workbench from an Unearther core, four thaumium plates and two simple mechanisms. It is built with the same frame as the ordinary Unearther.
It has no use for food: while a node, a node jar, a flux jar or a flux rift stands near it, it draws power from it every few moments and works faster. Without power it works at the normal speed, unless the settings say otherwise. A hungry node is never a safe source.
There is nothing for sand to hold on to in the void. A core of void metal should let the work finish almost before it has begun.

The Void Metal Unearther is made at the arcane workbench from an Alchemical Brass Unearther core, four void metal plates and two complex mechanisms.
It is the fastest of the three and the one that reaches the farthest for power, and it is also the one that takes the most. A hungry node is never a safe source.
Thaumium listens to the hand that holds it. A brush of thaumium should feel the glint of amber under the sand before the bristles ever touch it.

The brush trembles faintly whenever there is something worth finding.<PAGE>Thaumium Brush<DIV>It is made at the arcane workbench from a brass brush, three thaumium plates and a feather. It is sturdier and works faster than the brass brush, and it unearths vis crystals, amber and raw cinnabar far more often.
The void does not sweep away the sand, it simply is not there, and whatever was hidden in it is left behind. A void brush should find treasure that no other tool could reach.

The bristles are dark and weightless, and the sand parts for them.<PAGE>Void Metal Brush<DIV>It is made at the arcane workbench from a thaumium brush, three void metal plates and a feather. It is the most durable and the fastest of the three, and it gives the best odds of vis crystals, amber and raw cinnabar.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.industri: The machines of Industrial Foregoing are hungry for something better than gold and diamond. Their dissolution chambers drink latex from rubber trees, but I know a far deadlier solvent. If Liquid Death can eat through flesh and bone, it should have no trouble melting brass plates into a chip that a machine will accept.

The chip has set. Speed, efficiency, processing and range: a brass addon for each, and every one of them stronger than the diamond originals.<PAGE>Brass Addons<DIV>They are made in an Industrial Foregoing dissolution chamber from three brass plates, redstone, a glass pane, the material of each addon and Liquid Death. Place them in the addon slots of a machine, or use them on the machine directly. The values can be changed in the configuration.
Brass carries the current, but thaumium carries the intent. A chip wrapped in thaumium and bound with a simple mechanism should tell a machine not only to work harder, but how.

The thaumium has taken to the chip like a second circuit.<PAGE>Thaumium Addons<DIV>Each one is made in an Industrial Foregoing dissolution chamber from the brass addon of the same kind, three thaumium plates, a simple mechanism, the material of the addon, a diamond and a larger measure of Liquid Death.
A machine with a void metal chip does not so much work faster as work from somewhere the clock does not reach. The void swallows the waiting between one operation and the next.

The chips are dark, cold and impossibly quick.<PAGE>Void Metal Addons<DIV>Each one is made in an Industrial Foregoing dissolution chamber from the thaumium addon of the same kind, three void metal plates, a complex mechanism, the material of the addon, an eye of ender and a great deal of Liquid Death.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.infinity:
No wand I can build will ever run dry of vis, unless it is made of something that never runs dry itself.
Neutronium has the weight and infinity has the reach. Crystal matrix, shaped into caps, should let the magic flow without any cost at all.

The wand is far too grand for an arcane workbench. It can only be built in an Extreme Crafting Table:
- - - - - - C - -
- - - - - C I C -
- - - - - N I I C
- - - - N I N C -
- - - N X N - - -
- C N I N - - - -
C I I N - - - - -
- C I C - - - - -
- - C - - - - - -
C: Crystal Matrix Ingot, N: Neutron Ingot, I: Infinity Ingot, X: Block of Infinity.
A wand with the Infinity rod refills every primal aspect on its own, and the Infinity Cap makes its spells free. The cap is infused at the altar on top of a Neutronium Cap, with four infinity ingots and two infinity plates.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.infusion: The pillars and the pedestals of the infusion altar are only stone, and stone is what limits it. If they were made of the metals of Avaritia, the altar would ask for less and answer faster.

The infusion pillar stones are made at the arcane workbench, four at a time, from ingots and the stones of the tier before: the Crystal Matrix ones start from Eldritch Stone Tiles, the Neutronium ones from the Crystal Matrix ones and the Infinity ones from the Neutronium ones, with an Extremely Primordial Pearl.
The pedestals are infused from the pedestal of the tier before, starting from the Eldritch Pedestal, on an altar whose center is the Runic Matrix of their own tier.
The altar is built exactly like the plain one: eight stones, a pedestal and a Runic Matrix of any kind. Salis Mundus turns the stones into pillars of the same tier, and the look of the pillars follows the stone used.
Each tier lowers the cost and the cycle time of the altar more than the one before, and the pillars also add stability for the plain Runic Matrix. The exact values are set in the configuration.

The Runic Matrix keeps an infusion in order only while the altar around it is perfectly balanced. I have no wish to be bound to that symmetry.
If the matrix were made of the metals that stretched my jars, it could keep its own order, and answer for it with its own disorder.

Each Runic Matrix is made on an infusion altar, starting from the one before it:
- The Runic Matrix (Crystal Matrix) needs a Runic Matrix and crystal matrix ingots.
- The Runic Matrix (Neutronium) needs the Crystal Matrix one and neutron ingots.
- The Runic Matrix (Infinity) needs the Neutronium one, infinity ingots and an Extremely Primordial Pearl.
They infuse exactly like the Runic Matrix and sit on the same altar, but they never ask for a symmetric altar and their stability does not recover. What goes wrong is decided by the instability of the craft being infused, and it is never gentle:
- The Crystal Matrix one suffers solar instability: it burns, sets fires and calls lightning, and every craft is twice as unstable by day.
- The Neutronium one suffers nuclear instability: it gives off radiation, pours flux and can melt down in an explosion.
- The Infinity one counts every unit of essentia it receives as twenty, and it suffers cosmic instability, the most dangerous of all: it tears open flux, gives warp, summons creatures from beyond and throws everything near it somewhere else.
Each one can only be infused on an altar whose center is the tier before it: the Crystal Matrix one on a plain Runic Matrix, the Neutronium one on the Crystal Matrix one and the Infinity one on the Neutronium one.
Everything else I infuse from these metals answers to the same disorder: jars, flux jars, brain boxes, workbench chargers, node stabilizers, scribing tools, foci, wand parts and the pedestals of the altar. Each of those can only be infused on an altar whose center is the Runic Matrix of its own tier, so the Crystal Matrix ones suffer solar instability, the Neutronium ones nuclear instability and the Infinity ones cosmic instability. Their tooltip says which matrix they need.
How strong each of these is, and whether each tier asks for its own matrix, can be set in the configuration.
The Infusion Speed Stone and the Infusion Cost Stone help the altar, but only a little, and each asks something back. The metals of Avaritia should ask for less and give more.

Each stone is made on an infusion altar, starting from the one before it, with four ingots of its metal and, for the Infinity ones, an Extremely Primordial Pearl:
- The Crystal Matrix stones start from the Infusion Cost Stone or the Infusion Speed Stone.
- The Neutronium stones start from the Crystal Matrix ones.
- The Infinity stones start from the Neutronium ones.
Each stone can only be infused on an altar whose Runic Matrix is the tier before it: the Crystal Matrix ones on a plain Runic Matrix, the Neutronium ones on the Crystal Matrix one and the Infinity ones on the Neutronium one.
They go under the four pillars of the altar just like the plain stones, and each tier lowers the cost or the cycle time of the altar more than the one before. The altar never costs less than half, and the exact values are set in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.magical_:
The ore base listens to the beam of the drill, but the engineers built a second base that does not dig stone: it draws fluids out of the deep earth when a lens tunes it to them.
It is the same beam and the same violet metal, with a tank where the ore base keeps its chest.

The Magical Fluid Laser Base is born on an infusion altar from an ordinary Fluid Laser Base and a bucket. It is the same machine with its screen painted purple: one lens slot that chooses the fluid, the depth that decides where it can be found and a tank of 32000 mB with its bucket slots.
It needs no power of its own: it advances every time a Laser Drill, mundane or magical, sends its beam into it. An efficiency addon shortens the work, and the fluid can be pumped out of the tank as in the original.
The number of steps and the base itself can be changed in its configuration.

The Infinity Drill of the industrial engineers gets bigger the more power it swallows, and it swallows a lot of it. It is a hungry, mundane thing that needs a charger, a cable and a tank of fuel.
I know how to store vis inside an object and how to make a tool recharge itself from the aura around me. I also know a liquid that devours everything it touches. Put together, they should feed a drill that grows with the magic it holds.

The Magical Infinity Drill is born on an infusion altar from an Infinity Drill. It mines a whole area at once and drops everything at my feet, just like the original, but it holds vis instead of power. A Recharge Pedestal fills it, and while its charging is on it also draws vis slowly from the aura around me.
The more vis it holds, the wider the area: nothing at first, then 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, 9x9, 11x11 and, when it is almost full, the Artifact level, a 13x13x13 cube. Every mined block costs 1 vis and the drill falls back to a smaller level as it empties. Its tank takes Liquid Death, which is spent instead of vis without lowering the level. Right click on a source of Liquid Death fills the tank.
Shift and right click steps the area down one level, wrapping back to the largest one. Right click on air turns the charging on or off. The vis cost, the levels, the speed, the tank and the rest can be changed in its configuration.

The laser drill of the industrial engineers does nothing by itself: it only sends its beam into a laser base, which does the real digging, and it needs a steady stream of mundane power to do even that.
I already know how to draw vis straight out of the aura, and nodes hold more power than any wire ever carried. Joining the two should give me a drill that needs no cables at all.

The Magical Laser Drill is born on an infusion altar from an ordinary Laser Drill. It looks and works like the original, with the same screen painted purple, but its bar holds vis instead of power.
Place it so that its emitting face looks at any Laser Base, mundane or magical. The base must be inside the area of three blocks per side centred two blocks in front of it, and the screen shows the target it found. Every operation spends 1 vis, which is worth the 1000 power of the original, and gives one step of work to the base.
The vis is taken from the aura of its own chunk and, when the aura cannot pay, from a node, a jarred node, a Flux Jar, a Rift Jar or a flux rift within reach. A hungry node is never a source. Redstone, addons and the settings of the machine work as in the original. The cost, the speed, the buffer and the sources can all be changed in its configuration.

The magical drill sends its beam, but something has to receive it and turn it into stone and metal. The base of the industrial engineers does it with lenses of colored glass that tilt the odds toward the ore of their color.
The beam is the same and so is the digging. All I need is a base wrapped in the same violet metal as the drill.

The Magical Ore Laser Base is born on an infusion altar from an ordinary Ore Laser Base and a diamond pickaxe. It is the same machine with its screen painted purple: six lens slots, fifteen output slots and the depth that decides which ores can appear.
Lenses raise the chance of the ores of their color, and the work needs no power of its own: it advances every time a Laser Drill, mundane or magical, sends its beam into it. An efficiency addon shortens the work. Hoppers and pipes can take the output out as in the original.
The number of steps, the weight given by each lens and the base itself can be changed in its configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.matrix_w: Quartz is clear and orderly, and crystal matrix is that same order taken to its limit. A rod and a cap made from it should channel vis without losing any at all.

The Crystal Matrix Rod is crafted from three crystal matrix ingots at an arcane workbench. The Crystal Matrix Cap needs three ingots and two crystal matrix plates, the same plates used to build golems.
Assembled into a wand, they hold 1000 vis and its spells cost nothing.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.mekanism: The energized thaumium tools drink from the well, but only a little at a time. Brass is the metal that listens best to the aura, and a plain iron tool bound with alchemical brass, with the thaumium tool I already have as its first draught, might be taught to drink deeper.

The plan is simple enough. A normal iron tool, the energized thaumium tool of the same kind, two energy tablets, an infused alloy, a basic control circuit and two alchemical brass plates, all together on an infusion altar.<PAGE>Energized Alchemical Brass Tools<DIV>The infusion altar gives me an energized alchemical brass pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe or sword from the matching iron tool, and the energized thaumium tool is consumed in the process. They work like the thaumium ones: they lose no durability, they hold energy and every block mined, every hit and every stripped, flattened or tilled block spends some of it. With no energy left they are as useless as bare hands.<PAGE>They hold more energy, spend less of it and work faster than the thaumium ones. The capacity, the cost of every action, the mining speed and the damage can be changed in the configuration.

The thaumium tools never tire, but they wear out all the same, and a tool that wears out has to be mended or thrown away. The machines of Mekanism do not wear out: they feed on a stored current and ask for nothing else. I wonder whether a tool of thaumium can be taught to drink from the same well.

The plan is simple enough. A normal thaumium tool, two energy tablets, a reinforced alloy, an advanced control circuit and two thaumium plates, all together on an infusion altar.<PAGE>Energized Thaumium Tools<DIV>The infusion altar gives me an energized thaumium pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe or sword from the matching normal tool. They no longer lose durability. They hold energy, and every block mined, every hit on a creature and every stripped, flattened or tilled block spends some of it. They are charged in an energy cube, a charge pad, a charging slot of any Mekanism machine or with any other source of energy, and the charge bar under the item shows what is left. With no energy left they mine like bare hands, drop nothing a tool should drop and hit like a fist, until I charge them again.<PAGE>They are the first of the energized tools: they hold the least energy, spend the most of it and work the slowest, and the alchemical brass ones improve on them. The capacity, the cost of every action, the mining speed and the damage can be changed in the configuration.
Void metal mends itself, which is the one thing a machine will never do. Yet a void tool that is also fed by a current should never be found wanting, neither by wear nor by hunger.

A normal void metal tool, the energized alchemical brass tool of the same kind, two energy tablets, an atomic alloy, an ultimate control circuit and two void metal plates, on the infusion altar.<PAGE>Energized Void Metal Tools<DIV>These tools come from the normal void metal ones, and the energized alchemical brass tool is consumed in the process. They work like the brass ones, with a far larger store of energy, a lower cost for every action, a faster mining speed and a stronger blow. They also lose no durability and they too are useless once the energy is gone. They are made in the infusion altar one by one: pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword.<PAGE>The capacity, the cost of every action, the mining speed and the damage can be changed in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.neutroni:
Crystal matrix is only the first step. Neutronium is a star's heart pressed into metal, and a rod and a cap forged from it should hold far more power and waste far less of it.
The new parts must be built on top of the crystal matrix ones, and I will need the aspect of the end of things to bind the neutron ingots to them.

Both parts are infused with two neutron ingots and two neutronium plates. The Neutronium Cap uses a Crystal Matrix Cap as its catalyst, and the Neutronium Rod uses a Crystal Matrix Rod.
Assembled into a wand, they hold 5000 vis and cut the cost of every spell by half.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.node_pow:
Flux is only a danger while it is loose. A vessel lined with void metal should be able to draw it out of the aura of its chunk and keep it.
Whatever machine stands beside it could then burn that flux, instead of letting it poison the land.

The Flux Jar is made on an arcane workbench from a warded jar surrounded by four void metal plates.
It slowly pulls flux from the aura around it until it is full, and machines that work on magical power can use that flux as their source. A hungry node is never a safe source, and neither is a jar that has been broken: breaking the Flux Jar pours everything it holds back into the aura.

A jar of void metal holds only so much, and it fills only so fast. The same materials that stretched my warded jars should stretch these ones too.
Crystal matrix, neutronium and infinity should let a Flux Jar hold far more and draw the aura far quicker.

Each Flux Jar is made on an infusion altar, starting from the one before it:
- The Crystal Matrix Flux Jar needs a Flux Jar and crystal matrix ingots.
- The Neutronium Flux Jar needs a Crystal Matrix Flux Jar and neutron ingots.
- The Infinity Flux Jar needs a Neutronium Flux Jar, infinity ingots and an Extremely Primordial Pearl.
They work like the plain Flux Jar, only bigger and faster, and breaking one still pours its flux back into the aura.

A flux rift cannot be sealed, only worn down. The Void Siphon already shrinks one a little at a time and gives me seeds for my trouble.
If a jar could do the same with the tear itself, it would keep what the rift gives up instead of letting it spill.

The Rift Jar is made on an arcane workbench from a warded jar, two void seeds and two void metal plates.
Set beside a flux rift, it takes the rift apart one point at a time and keeps that as power for any machine that uses magical power. It stops once the rift is down to its smallest size. A broken Rift Jar spills what it still holds back into the aura as flux.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.oritech_: The addons of Oritech make a machine faster, thriftier or hungrier for storage, but their plating is only plating. Brass plates and a simple mechanism should carry the current with fewer losses.

Each addon is built at the arcane workbench around the Oritech addon of the same kind, with brass plates, simple mechanisms and a component of Oritech:
- Speed: processes in 40% of the time (Oritech's addon: 50%) and spends 110% of the energy.
- Efficiency: spends 60% of the energy (Oritech's addon: 80%).
- Capacitor: adds 10,000,000 of capacity and 10,000 of insert rate to the machine.
They are placed against the machine like any other addon. Every value can be changed in the configuration.

The engineers of Oritech found veins that never run dry: nodes of bedrock that a deep drill can bleed forever. If the same trick works with cinnabar, amber and quartz, I will never have to dig for them again.

On the infusion altar, a resource node of Oritech surrounded by the ore and the product of the material becomes a node of that material:
- Cinnabar (from the Redstone node), Amber (Gold node) and Quartz (Lapis node), with the Thaumaturge ore and its drop.
Under Oritech's Deep Drill each node gives its material forever: raw cinnabar, amber or quartz. They also generate in the overworld like the nodes of Oritech, with a boulder of deepslate on the surface.
The amount per cycle and how rare each node is can be changed in the configuration, and every node can be turned off there.
Thaumium holds a charge of magic that brass cannot. An addon made of it, with a complex mechanism, should push a machine well past what brass allows.

Each addon is built around the brass addon of the same kind, with thaumium plates, complex mechanisms and an overcharged crystal:
- Speed: processes in 20% of the time and spends 100% of the energy.
- Efficiency: spends 40% of the energy.
- Capacitor: adds 100,000,000 of capacity and 100,000 of insert rate.

The engineers of Oritech steal the spark of thought from an Allay or a Vex with a dubious container, or boil it out of strange matter in a centrifuge. But I already keep a mind in a jar. If a brain in a jar can think, a vessel built to hold what machines cannot should be able to hold that thought too.

At the arcane workbench, a Brain in a Jar, a clockwork mind, two complex mechanisms, four thaumium plates and a Dubious Container of Oritech become an Unholy Intelligence, the same logic core that Oritech obtains by capturing an Allay or from the centrifuge.
The workbench needs the vis and the order and entropy crystals shown in the recipe. The recipe can be turned off in the configuration.
Void metal gives nothing back to the world, and that includes losses. An addon made of it should be as close as a machine can get to working for free.

Each addon is built around the thaumium addon of the same kind, with void metal plates, complex mechanisms and a Heisenberg compensator:
- Speed: processes in 10% of the time and spends 90% of the energy.
- Efficiency: spends 20% of the energy.
- Capacitor: adds 1,000,000,000 of capacity and 1,000,000 of insert rate.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.planetar: The Endest Pearl of Avaritia opens a gaping void wherever it lands, and a void only swallows. But the Primordial Pearl taught me that a pearl is a small world, and a world can have neighbours. If I bind metals to the pearl one after another, it might call the planets themselves to circle what it strikes.

The Planetary Endest Pearls are made on an infusion altar. The Copper one needs an Avaritia Endest Pearl and four copper ingots, and every following pearl needs the one before it and four units of its own material:
- Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Emerald and Netherite: copper ingots, iron ingots, gold ingots, diamonds, emeralds and netherite ingots.
They are thrown with right click like an ender pearl. When one hits a creature, planets named after those of the sky, Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars and so on, orbit it on different orbits, each with its own speed and slant, and hurt it again and again until they fade. When one hits a block, the planets orbit the closest creature within reach, and if there is none they orbit the point of impact and hurt whatever enters their reach. They never hurt the thrower, or their team and tamed animals, unless the configuration says so. Bosses take only a limited amount of damage from each planet.
The Netherite pearl is the first that kills bosses: its planets ignore armor, resistance and the shield of what they hit, and it is unbreakable, so it never wears out when thrown, only held back by its cooldown. The lower pearls have durability: every throw wears one point and the pearl breaks with the last one. Copper has 3, Iron 5, Gold 8, Diamond 12 and Emerald 16 (set in the configuration).
Every pearl's planets, damage, interval, duration, orbit and cooldown are set in the configuration.
Copper and iron summon a few small planets, but the pearl still asks for more. Thaumaturgy and the metals of Avaritia could widen its orbits until the whole sky turns around a single target.

The higher Planetary Endest Pearls are made on an infusion altar from the previous pearl and four units of their own material:
- Thaumium: thaumium ingots.
- Alchemical Brass: alchemical brass ingots.
- Void Metal: void metal ingots.
- Blaze Cube: Avaritia blaze cubes and two Blaze Cube Salis Mundus.
- Crystal Matrix: Crystal Matrix ingots and four Crystal Matrix Salis Mundus.
- Neutronium: neutron ingots and six Neutronium Salis Mundus.
- Infinity: infinity ingots and eight Infinity Salis Mundus.
Each one summons more planets, that hit harder and faster and stay longer, and the infusion grows more unstable the higher the pearl goes. They use the new essences of this addon, Cosmic, Nuclear and Sol.
The Void Metal and Infinity pearls kill bosses like the Netherite one: their planets ignore armor, resistance and invulnerability, and can finish the Wither and the Ender Dragon. They are unbreakable too, so they never wear out. The Creative pearl has no recipe: it is only found in the creative tab, it kills bosses and is unbreakable as well, and it summons as many planets as the Infinity one for much longer.
The Thaumium, Alchemical Brass, Blaze Cube, Crystal Matrix and Neutronium pearls have durability, with 32, 64, 128, 256 and 512 points respectively, and bosses only take a limited amount of damage from them.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.projecte: The philosopher's stone of another craft weighs every thing by what it is worth, and I could teach it to weigh mine. If it knows what iron, gold and diamond are worth, it should learn the worth of thaumium, alchemical brass and void metal, and of everything I forge from them.

With ProjectE installed, everything made on the arcane workbench, in the crucible and on the infusion altar gets EMC from the items it is made of, exactly as the dusts and ingots of the vanilla table do. The aspects, the vis and the instability of the recipe add nothing.
The materials that no recipe produces have a value of their own: thaumium ingots are worth more than iron and less than gold, alchemical brass ingots more than gold and less than diamond, and void metal ingots more than diamond and less than netherite. Amber, quicksilver, salis mundus, void seeds and the rest of the raw materials are worth what they would be in the vanilla table.
Creative items, unbreakable pearls and crucifixes, wands and jars that hold a charge or contents carry no EMC.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.purifica:
A creature that has been infected is not lost forever, I am sure of it. The taint clings to it the way flux clings to the aura, and I have already learned how to coax flux out of the aura.
A cleansing brew, steeped with the life of the world and the order that flux hates, should be able to wash the taint out of a creature, much like the old silverleaf tonics.
To understand how the taint takes hold I must first observe one of its own creatures, up close.

The brew works. Thrown at the ground, the potion shatters into a bright, clean mist, and every infected creature standing in it returns to its natural self, health, temper and all.
It cures pets, livestock and monsters alike, and it also drives the flux sickness out of the blood before it can finish a creature off.Purification Splash Potion
It is brewed in the crucible from Ordo, Victus, Aqua and Lux, with an Ethereal Bloom as the catalyst.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.purity.s: Taint does not only eat the land. It eats whatever stands on it, and I cannot always afford to put down the creature it has taken. If the aura can be cleansed, the flesh should be able to be cleansed as well.
Everything I learn about driving the taint out of living creatures is gathered in this tab.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.salis_mu:
The Salis Mundus opens the way for every structure I wake with it, and yet it is only a pinch of salt. If I fold the heaviest materials of Avaritia into it inside an infusion altar, I should obtain dusts that still wake the same structures but carry the weight of those materials.
Blaze cube, crystal matrix, neutronium and infinity should each give a variant, every one built on the one before it.

Each variant is infused on an altar, starting from the previous dust, with four units of its material, and gives four dusts:
- The Blaze Cube Salis Mundus needs the Salis Mundus and four blaze cubes.
- The Crystal Matrix Salis Mundus needs the Blaze Cube Salis Mundus and four crystal matrix ingots.
- The Neutronium Salis Mundus needs the Crystal Matrix Salis Mundus and four neutronium ingots.
- The Infinity Salis Mundus needs the Neutronium Salis Mundus and four infinity ingots.
All of them work exactly like the Salis Mundus and wake the same structures.
The Crystal Matrix, Neutronium and Infinity ones can only be infused on an altar whose center is the Runic Matrix of their own tier, with the instability that matrix brings.
These dusts are the ones asked for by the recipes of the planetary pearls and star crucifixes of the blaze cube, crystal matrix, neutronium and infinity levels.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.solarflu: Sunlight is only light, and light is only a thing to be shaped. If I bind the aspect of the sun into a plain solar panel inside the crucible, it should keep drinking the light long after the sun has set.

The crucible has dissolved the sun into the panel. The Sol it holds is tame, and the panel now generates far more energy than it ever did.<PAGE>Alchemical Solar Panel<DIV>Dropping a tier 8 solar panel into a crucible filled with Sol and Machina turns it into an alchemical solar panel. If Twilight Forest is installed the catalyst is its tier 2 panel (fiery), and if Draconic Evolution is installed it is the chaotic panel.
Brass conducts the sun's light better than anything I have set beside it. Wrapping an alchemical panel in brass plating and photovoltaic cells should wring far more energy out of every ray.

The brass plating channels the light into the panel without losing it.<PAGE>Alchemical Brass Solar Panel<DIV>It is crafted at the arcane workbench from photovoltaic cells, brass plates and an alchemical solar panel.
Thaumium takes magic as easily as brass takes light. A matrix of thaumium plates and refined photovoltaic cells should let a panel shine with an energy that no craftsman could ever give it.

The infusion altar has fused the plates and cells into a single, steady source of power.<PAGE>Thaumium Solar Panel<DIV>It is infused over an alchemical brass solar panel using thaumium plates, advanced photovoltaic cells and a simple mechanism.
Void metal swallows light the way the void swallows everything else. If I give it the purest photovoltaic cells and a complex mechanism, it should turn the faintest ray into a torrent of energy.

The panel drinks light that would otherwise vanish into nothing.<PAGE>Void Metal Solar Panel<DIV>It is infused over a thaumium solar panel using void metal plates, the finest photovoltaic cells and a complex mechanism.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.sophisti:
I carry my tools in a pack, but the arcane workbench still ties me to one spot. If the crafting upgrade of the backpack makers can bring a workbench along, it should be able to bring mine too.
It will have to take its vis from the aura beneath my feet, since I will not carry a wand for it.

The Arcane Workbench Upgrade is made on an arcane workbench from a Crafting Upgrade, an Arcane Workbench, thaumium plates and a few crystals of each primal aspect.
In a backpack or storage it opens a tab identical to the one of the Crafting Upgrade, with the same crafting grid, result slot, shift click target and refill buttons, plus six slots for the primal crystals the recipes ask for, a wand slot that pays the vis like the wand of an arcane workbench, and a charger slot that takes a workbench charger and gives its vis discount and radius. It crafts every recipe of the arcane workbench I have researched, and the vis comes from the aura of the chunk I stand in.

The netherite backpack is the best the backpack makers can sew. A pack lined with vis-forged metal should hold more and wear more upgrades than that.
Each metal I have mastered should give a backpack that beats the one before it.

Every backpack is crafted from the one below it, surrounded by eight plates of the new metal, and keeps all its contents and upgrades. The Thaumium Backpack is made from a Netherite Backpack, the Alchemical Brass Backpack from the Thaumium one, and the Void Metal Backpack from the Alchemical Brass one.
The number of inventory slots and upgrade slots of each one is set in the configuration.

The stack upgrades of the backpack makers stop at a multiplier that any warehouse outgrows. A plate of vis-forged metal in the same frame should keep holding items long after theirs would burst.
Each metal I have mastered should hold far more than the one before it.

Every stack upgrade is infused from the one below it, with four plates of the new metal. The Thaumium Stack Upgrade is infused from the highest stack upgrade of Sophisticated Backpacks or Sophisticated Storage, the Alchemical Brass one from the Thaumium one, and the Void Metal one from the Alchemical Brass one. Alchemical Brass and Thaumium add a simple mechanism and Void Metal a void seed.
They work in any backpack or storage like the upgrades of Sophisticated and share their limit of stack upgrades. The multiplier of each one is set in the configuration.

Chests, barrels and shulker boxes of netherite are the best the storage makers can build, and my warehouse is already bursting. Vis-forged metal should let them hold and carry far more.
Each metal I have mastered should give a storage that beats the one before it.

Every barrel, limited barrel, chest and shulker box is crafted from the one below it, surrounded by eight plates of the new metal, and keeps all its contents and upgrades. The Thaumium ones are made from the Netherite ones, the Alchemical Brass ones from the Thaumium ones, and the Void Metal ones from the Alchemical Brass ones.
The inventory slots, upgrade slots and slot limit multipliers of each one are set in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.star_cru:
A cross that waits in my hand until something dares to strike me. Then starlight chains should leave it, close around the creature, lift it, and drag it under the ground where it dies. The same should happen if I only point it at a hostile creature and use it.
The metals I know could give it different strengths: the weaker ones bind only small creatures and weaken with every use, the stronger ones bind almost anything and last forever.

A Star Crucifix works when a creature strikes its bearer, in either hand, or when it is used while aiming at a hostile creature within its range. Starlight chains bind the creature, it rises, hangs in the air and is dragged underground, where it dies and drops its loot on the surface. Only one binding can be active for each player at a time. A creature with more maximum health than the crucifix allows, and every boss if the crucifix cannot kill bosses, resists: the chains strain, the creature roars, the chains snap one by one and the crucifix cracks and explodes, throwing its bearer away, stunned. The blow that triggered it still lands.
Every crucifix is made on an infusion altar. The Copper one needs a Totem of Undying and four copper ingots, and every following one needs the crucifix before it and four units of its own material:
- Iron, Gold, Diamond, Emerald and Netherite: iron ingots, gold ingots, diamonds, emeralds and netherite ingots.
- Thaumium, Alchemical Brass and Void Metal: their ingots.
- Blaze Cube: Avaritia blaze cubes and two Blaze Cube Salis Mundus.
- Crystal Matrix: Crystal Matrix ingots and four Crystal Matrix Salis Mundus.
- Neutronium: neutron ingots and six Neutronium Salis Mundus.
- Infinity: infinity ingots and eight Infinity Salis Mundus.
The higher the crucifix, the more unstable the infusion. The Crystal Matrix, Neutronium and Infinity crucifixes are infused like the other things of their material, on an altar whose center is the Runic Matrix of their own tier. The Neutronium and Infinity crucifixes also ask for the new essence Nuclear, and the Infinity one for Cosmic too.
By default each crucifix binds creatures of up to this much maximum health: Copper 30, Iron 60, Gold 100, Diamond 200, Emerald 300, Thaumium 500, Alchemical Brass 800, Blaze Cube 1500, Crystal Matrix 3000 and Neutronium 6000. The Netherite, Void Metal and Infinity ones have no limit. The higher ones reach farther and hold the creature for less time before dragging it down.
The Netherite, Void Metal and Infinity crucifixes kill bosses: bosses are bound and dragged underground like any creature, the Wither and the Ender Dragon included, without the crucifix failing. They are also unbreakable and never wear out. The others have durability and every activation wears one point, even when the creature resists: Copper has 3, Iron 5, Gold 8, Diamond 12, Emerald 16, Thaumium 32, Alchemical Brass 64, Blaze Cube 128, Crystal Matrix 256 and Neutronium 512. The Creative crucifix has no recipe and is only found in the creative tab: it binds anything, kills bosses and is unbreakable.
Limits, range, binding time, durability and whether each crucifix kills bosses are set in the configuration.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.tainted_: The flux that spoils a field has no respect for a hearth either. If a stew simmered in the crucible takes in enough vitium, the meals of Farmer's Delight should come out heavier with hunger, and with something else besides.

The soup smells wrong, and yet it smells wonderful.Tainted Farmer's Feasts
Fill a crucible with enough vitium and drop the meal into it as the catalyst. Beef stew, chicken soup, vegetable soup, fish stew, baked cod stew, noodle soup, fried rice, ratatouille, steak and potatoes, hamburgers, bacon sandwiches, cooked bacon, beef patties and dumplings each have their own recipe.
A tainted meal fills more hunger and more saturation than the original and keeps its effects, but whoever eats it is struck by Flux Taint for a while.The Cooking Pot
The Cooking Pot and the Cutting Board of Farmer's Delight accept tainted ingredients too. Tainted cooked beef, carrots and baked potatoes in the pot give a tainted beef stew, steak and potatoes or vegetable soup, and fried rice if there is rice, eggs and onion beside them. A knife on the Cutting Board turns tainted cooked beef into tainted beef patties and tainted cooked porkchops into tainted cooked bacon.

The flux that spoils a field can also be coaxed into a loaf of bread. If the crucible is fed enough vitium, whatever edible I drop into it should come out heavier with hunger, and with something else besides.

A little flux has soaked into the food.Tainted Food
Fill a crucible with enough vitium and drop the food into it as the catalyst. Bread, apples, carrots, baked potatoes, steak, cooked porkchops, pumpkin pies and mushroom stew each have their own recipe, and so do the Ultimate Stew and the Cosmic Meatballs of Avaritia.
The tainted food fills more hunger and more saturation than the original and keeps its effects, but whoever eats it is struck by Flux Taint for a while.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.tech.sta: Machines and magic do not have to be enemies. Wherever a tool of iron and gears meets the aura, I should be able to bend one to the other.
Everything that joins my thaumaturgy to the technology of other mods is gathered in this tab.
research.thaumaturgetechcompats.tech_ess: Four essences keep showing up in my notes that are not among the primal ones: Sol, Terminus, Nuclear and Cosmic. They do not cling to just any material, so I should learn where they hide and what they leave behind in everything made from them.

Each of these essences sits in the base resources, and the items built from them carry it on.
- Sol, the power of the sun: glowstone dust and blocks, blaze rods and powder, magma cream, daylight detectors, sea lanterns, sunflowers, torchflowers, honey and amber, a little gold, the cells and panels of Solar Flux, the blaze and sunny quartz of Botania and the photovoltaic parts of Ender IO.
- Terminus, the end of everything: the late game of Avaritia, such as infinity ingots, tools and armor, the Endest Pearl, the singularities and the higher Neutronium Collectors and Compressors.
- Nuclear, radiation and fission: ancient debris, netherite, TNT and end crystals in small amounts, the uranium, plutonium, polonium and thorium of Mekanism and Oritech, their pellets and reactor rods, and the neutronium of Avaritia.
- Cosmic, the stars and the infinite: nether stars, eyes of ender, ender pearls, dragon eggs and breath, shulker shells, elytra, chorus fruit, echo shards, amethyst, the Crystal Matrix and Infinity ingots, the Endest Pearl and the Void Seed.
Whatever is crafted from these resources inherits their essences according to what it is made of, whether the material is vanilla, from Thaumaturge or from another mod: the Void Metal Ingot, brewed around a Void Seed, carries Cosmic, and a Neutronium Gear carries the Nuclear of its ingots. The same goes for the machines and tools of every other mod installed.

thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.advanced_a: The Advanced Alchemical Furnace has a 3x3 base: an Essentia Smeltery in the centre, surrounded by Advanced Alchemical Constructs.
On top go Arcane Alembics on the corners and Alchemical Constructs between them, leaving the middle open.
Sprinkle Salis Mundus over it and the whole structure fuses into a single machine.
It burns no fuel. It draws ignis, perditio and aqua from nearby vis relays or nodes to stay hot, and items dropped onto its core break down quickly while it does.
The essentia collects inside and tubes can draw it from the nozzles on each side. If the structure is broken, whatever it holds escapes as flux.
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.golem_pres: The Golem Press is a small structure: a Cauldron, an Anvil, a Stone Table and a Piston facing up, with a block of iron bars on top of the piston.
Sprinkle Salis Mundus over it and it becomes a single press.
Supply it with Machina essentia through the ports below the press and use it to pick the components of your golem.
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.infernal_f: The Infernal Furnace is a 3x3x3 cube of Nether Bricks and Obsidian with a single block of lava in the middle.
A block of iron bars in front of the lava is the outlet. Sprinkle Salis Mundus over the structure to form the furnace.
Drop items in from the top. They are smelted without fuel and spat out the front, and items that cannot be smelted are destroyed. Now and then it yields bonus nuggets.
Place a chest or another container in front of it to collect the output. A steady supply of vis from the aura speeds it up, but it may occasionally create a little flux.
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.infusion_a: An Infusion Altar can also be built from Ancient Stone Tiles. The shape is the same: four pillars, a central pedestal and a Runic Matrix two blocks above it.
Sprinkle Salis Mundus to bind it. Ancient pillars lower the essentia cost, speed the infusion up a little and add a small amount of instability.
Ancient Pedestals placed around the altar lower the essentia cost as well. Put your ingredients on them as usual.
Start the infusion by clicking the Runic Matrix with a casting tool.
The Infusion Altar is built from Arcane Stone: four pillars, a pedestal in the middle and a Runic Matrix floating two blocks above it.
Sprinkle Salis Mundus over the structure to bind it. The pillars take shape and the altar is ready.
Place more pedestals around the altar and put the ingredients on them. The item to infuse goes on the central pedestal.
Click the Runic Matrix with a casting tool to begin. Essentia is drained from nearby containers and instability builds up while it works.
An Infusion Altar can also be built from Eldritch Stone Tiles. The shape is the same: four pillars, a central pedestal and a Runic Matrix two blocks above it.
Sprinkle Salis Mundus to bind it. Eldritch pillars reduce instability and speed the infusion up, at the price of a slightly higher essentia cost.
Eldritch Pedestals have the same effect, but keep them balanced: unbalanced Eldritch Pedestals massively increase instability.
Start the infusion by clicking the Runic Matrix with a casting tool.
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.node_energ: A Node Stabilizer placed directly beneath a node holds it still. The node feeds on the aura more slowly and no longer pulls from other nodes.

The Advanced Node Stabilizer is a stronger lock: the node barely feeds at all and nothing can pull from it, though it can still pull from unprotected nodes. A redstone signal switches either stabilizer off.
To energize a node, place a Node Transducer directly above it and power only the transducer with redstone.
Never let redstone reach the stabilizer. If it is removed or switched off beneath an energized node, the node tears itself apart in a violent explosion.
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.research_t: The Research Table is made of two blocks placed side by side.
Bookshelves, a Brain in a Jar and other blocks around it can grant bonus aspects when you work at the table.
Use it with scribing tools and paper to combine aspects and complete research.

thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.thaumatori: The Thaumatorium stacks two Alchemical Constructs on top of a Crucible.
Sprinkle Salis Mundus over it and the constructs become the Thaumatorium. The crucible base needs no water, but it still needs a heat source.
Essentia is drawn in through tubes and the finished object is ejected out of the front.
A Mnemonic Matrix attached to its side lets it keep track of two more formulas at the same time.
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.tiered_alc: Every Avaritia alchemical furnace is built exactly like the Advanced Alchemical Furnace, but with the matching Avaritia Essentia Smeltery in the centre instead of the Essentia Smeltery.
Sprinkle Salis Mundus to form it. The Crystal Matrix Alchemical Furnace works 2 times faster and gives back 25%% of the heat, perditio and aqua spent on each item (by default).
Neutronium Alchemical Furnace: 4 times faster and 50%% of the heat, perditio and aqua given back (by default).
Infinity Alchemical Furnace: 10 times faster and 90%% of the heat, perditio and aqua given back (by default).
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.tiered_mne: Avaritia Mnemonic Matrices attach to the sides of a Thaumatorium, facing it, just like the Mnemonic Matrix, but each one lets it keep track of more formulas at once. The Mnemonic Matrix gives 2.
Crystal Matrix Mnemonic Matrix: 4 formulas each (by default).
Neutronium Mnemonic Matrix: 6 formulas each (by default).
Infinity Mnemonic Matrix: 10 formulas each (by default).
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.tiered_nod: The Crystal Matrix, Neutronium and Infinity Node Stabilizers work like the Advanced Node Stabilizer: place them directly beneath a node. The basic one slows feeding 2 times and the advanced one 20 times.
Crystal Matrix Node Stabilizer: the node feeds on the aura 50 times slower (by default).
Neutronium Node Stabilizer: the node feeds on the aura 200 times slower (by default).
Infinity Node Stabilizer: the node feeds on the aura 1000 times slower (by default).
The Crystal Matrix, Neutronium and Infinity Node Transducers go directly above a node held by a stabilizer, just like the Node Transducer, and are powered with redstone in the same way.
Crystal Matrix Node Transducer: charges the node 2 times faster and loses its charge 2 times slower without redstone (by default).
Neutronium Node Transducer: charges the node 4 times faster and loses its charge 4 times slower without redstone (by default).
Infinity Node Transducer: charges the node 10 times faster and loses its charge 10 times slower without redstone (by default).
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.tiered_wor: Avaritia Workbench Chargers go on top of an Arcane Workbench like the Workbench Charger, but they reach farther and make arcane crafting cheaper. The Workbench Charger reaches 1 chunk around the workbench.
Crystal Matrix Workbench Charger: draws vis from 2 chunks around the workbench and charges 30%% less vis (by default).
Neutronium Workbench Charger: draws vis from 3 chunks around the workbench and charges 60%% less vis (by default).
Infinity Workbench Charger: draws vis from 4 chunks around the workbench and charges 90%% less vis (by default).
thaumaturgetechcompats.ponder.workbench_: A Workbench Charger placed on top of an Arcane Workbench lets it draw vis from the surrounding chunks too. The same rig works on the Focal Manipulator.
Vis is drawn from the chunk of the workbench and the eight around it, split between all nine so that no single chunk is depleted.
